note: Part of the core family: supply, roads, pack trains, Stored Essence and Provisions, and the seven resource descriptions. The economy spec (docs/specs/03_gameplay/02_economy.md) fixes the terms: oil is Essence, coal is Grain, energy is Provisions, fuel is Stored Essence, steel is Iron, aluminium is Timber, rubber is Horses, tungsten is Stone, chromium is Gold. The economy engineer may adjust the wording of this file; the keys and placeholders are fixed by the game.

lit.FUEL_CAPACITY_FILL_INFO: At the present rate, your {fuel} will be full in $DUR|G$
lit.FUEL_DESC: §H{fuel}§! is drawn from your realm's spare {oil}. Each realm has a greatest store of §H{fuel}§! which can be raised by building §HVaults§!. §H{fuel}§! is used by war engines, ships and wings and it is carried by the §HSupply Roads§!.
lit.LOGISTICS_CAPACITY_DETAILED_DESC: Supply capacity shows how well your supply lines are served. If your realm lacks the {train:p:lc} or the {truck:p:lc} needed to carry all the supply that is wanted, your {division:p:lc} will receive less and will suffer the penalties of poor supply.
lit.MAX_FUEL_BY_STATES_FACTOR_TOOLTIP: {fuel} capacity will change by $FACTOR|+%.0$ to a total of $TOTAL|.2H$
lit.OUT_OF_FUEL_INFO: At the present rate of use, your {fuel} will run dry in $DUR|R$

Days remaining: $DAYS$§!
lit.RAILWAY_UPGRADE_TOOLTIP: Improving the level $START_LEVEL|H$ {rail_way:lc} in $RAILWAY_NAME|H$ to level $TARGET_LEVEL|H$
lit.SUPPLYMODE_TOOLTIP_NODE_CONVOY_ZERO_EFFI: §RNo {convoy} Can Reach It! Supply Has Halted!§!
lit.SUPPLY_FLOW_DELAYED_DESC:
§HSupply Remaining§! shows how much supply reaches this province, and is made up of state supply and the {supply_node:p:lc} within reach. The reach of a {supply_node:lc} is affected by weather, the state of the ground, roads, {rail_way:lc} level and pack trains. 

§H{division:p}§! will draw on provincial supply according to their supply weight. If their §HStored Supply§! is above the supply ratio of their location, they will draw on their own store until it falls to the level of the local supply.

Hold §GCtrl§! to show where the flow comes from.
lit.SUPPLY_FLOW_SHOW_RANGE:
§H{supply_node:p}§! spread supply to nearby provinces. Their reach and strength depend on weather, the state of the ground, roads, {rail_way:lc} level and pack trains.

To widen the reach and raise the supply of a §H{supply_node}§!, consider the §HImprove {rail_way:p}§! command, changing the §HPack Train Level§! or raising the §HRoad Level§!.

Hold §GShift§! to show the reach.
§GShift-click§! to toggle pack trains.
§GCtrl-click§! to toggle supply for our league.
lit.SUPPLY_MAPICON_SUPPORTED_LIMITED_DESC:
This {supply_node:lc} could support more supply, but is limited by some §R'bottlenecks'§! on its route.
Consider improving the §Groads§! along the route.
Improve the harbours too if the route includes a sea path.
Then think about how many {convoy:p:lc} and guards are needed.
lit.SUPPLY_NODE_BUILD_RAIL:
§HBuild {rail_way:p}§!
Build a {rail_way:lc} from this {supply_node}.
§GHold Shift§! while clicking this button to use the best path automatically.
lit.SUPPLY_NODE_MOTORIZATION_PRIORITY:
§HPack Train Level§!
Pack trains for a {supply_node} come from the {stockpile}, and widen the reach of the {supply_node:lc} and the supply it gives to provinces.
§GClick§! to cycle through priorities.
lit.SUPPLY_NODE_TOGGLE_ALLIES:
§HLeague Supply§!
Toggle {supply_node} access for your league
lit.SUPPLY_NODE_UPGRADE_TO_CAPITAL:
§HImprove Bottlenecks§!
Queue improvements to the {rail_way} and harbour bottlenecks on the path from the Capital {supply_node}. This will raise the supply that can reach every province this node serves.
lit.SUPPLY_TRUCKS_DESC_DETAILED: {truck:p} carry supply from {supply_node:p:lc} to the armies.
lit.TOO_MANY_CONVOYS_FOR_CONVOY_ESCORT_DETAI: At lower strength, guard task forces cannot cover every {convoy:lc}. If {convoy:p:lc} are attacked, fewer ships will be there at the start of the fight to protect them.
lit.TOO_MANY_REGIONS_FOR_CONVOY_RAID: §R$NAME|H$ can raid {convoy:p:lc} well in at most $NUM|H$ regions. Its strength is lowered to $EFFICIENCY|%.0H$.§!
lit.TOO_MANY_REGIONS_FOR_CONVOY_RAID_DETAILE: At lower strength, raiding task forces find enemy {convoy:p:lc} less easily and bring fewer ships to the start of a fight.
lit.aluminium_desc: {aluminium} builds hulls, wagons and war engines.
lit.chromium_desc: {chromium} buys the finest arms and the loyalty of courts.
lit.coal_desc: {coal} feeds the workshops of the realm and the folk who work in them.
lit.oil_desc: {oil} is needed to work the great rites and the finest craft.
lit.rubber_desc: {rubber} draw the wagons and carry the riders of the realm.
lit.steel_desc: {steel} is the chief metal of swords, armour and the fittings of ships.
lit.tungsten_desc: {tungsten} raises walls and forts and is broken into siege shot.
